changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO scopes (scope_key, scope_name, project_id, access_control_model, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted) SELECT 'default_scope' as scope_name, 'default_scope' as scope_key, p.project_id, 'ABAC' as access_control_model, 'system' as created_by, NOW() as created_at, 'system' as updated_by, NOW() as updated_at, 0 as is_deleted FROM projects p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scopes s WHERE s.project_id = p.project_id AND s.scope_key = 'default_scope' AND s.access_control_model = 'ABAC') AND p.is_deleted = 0;
